'''Equilibrium''' is the 39th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 28 December 2018. The set consists of 11 virtual cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*10 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Bajoran, 6 Federation, 2 Klingon, and 4 Non-Aligned)

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
* 11 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
